decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings belong to the firm's core drainage families, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations the product gives no cause for problemistic search.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's direction toward accessible, low-profile systems and benefited from strong renovation demand, so it likely meets aspirations.
As the flagship designer line it carries the firm's design-quality positioning, and management would only drop it after clear negative feedback, which has not appeared.
The backflow-protected basement drain addresses a growing safety need from heavy-rain events and fits the established drainage range, so performance plausibly meets aspirations.
The air-admittance valve is peripheral to the bathroom-design focus but is a low-cost complementary line that organisational slack can carry, with no clear sign of a shortfall.
